source_read_groups.reporting_limit: The runtime evaluator emits one aggregate read count, not per-path read records. Groups identify its expected source set; no new reads or per-path observations are invented.

categories.grouping_basis: Fixed English category-to-case mapping selected from original query/filter semantics, not observed relevance outcomes. No corpus or relevance judgments changed.

metric_definitions.recall_at5: Unique relevant hits in the first five divided by all annotated relevant documents.
metric_definitions.reciprocal_rank_at5: Reciprocal of the first relevant rank within five, otherwise zero.
metric_definitions.macro: Arithmetic mean over positive queries only; overall is per-query weighted, not an unweighted mean of category means.
metric_definitions.negative_cases: Both metrics are null and excluded from macro means; require exactly zero ranked hits and total.
metric_definitions.floors: Per positive query min(5, relevant_count)/relevant_count and the original first-relevant-rank-one constraint. Six relevant notes require 5/6, not 1.

source_attribution.basis: Caller-supplied attribution; raw evaluator report has no executable identity. Parent must bind fresh final evidence independently.

limits: Grouping existing observed output only; no new product, context-citation or source-read execution.

validation_checks: complete original actual-report coverage and recomputed metrics
